generator: generate-world.mjs (Node.js, hand-rolled GLB writer, no OSM2World or Blender)
limitations: Building facades are extruded footprint polygons with a 0.45 m roof parapet. Per-building InstancedMesh window modules, doors and balconies are added at runtime by CityBuilder.ts for buildings within 220 m LOD radius; distant buildings remain unfenestrated extrusions.
Roads are ribbons with 0.45 m raised kerbs and dashed centre lane markings on major roads; intersections are implied by overlapping ribbons, not modelled explicitly.
No terrain elevation — everything is on Y=0 ground plane.
Materials are solid PBR colours (asphalt/bump textures are applied at runtime by WorldAssetLoader).
OSM data covers 2000 m (full 2 km radius).

player.type: skinned skeletal character, procedural fallback rig if load fails
player.backpack: procedural box mesh parented to model root

campus.instancedWindows: added to academic block East & West facades

city.instancing: one InstancedMesh per colour palette per component type
